m_dialogEntries.m_dialog: Intruder! No take eggs! Feed you to hatchlings!
Child of Light, you have wormed your way deep into the Shadow! What a tragedy, to die poorly in a Dragonfly Hatchery.
Shadow Blight! I curse your blood a thousand times! May your children devour you alive!
<ITALICS>You find a perfect Egg in the pond. It nearly hums with life. </ITALICS>
Ah, this Egg looks perfect. I can tell it will hatch into a noble beast.
Bear with me, this scheme has a lot of moving parts! We want to turn the Umbra Legion's weapons against them.
The plan is to get a Dragonfly and use it to drop an explosive barrel of Kermes Fire on the Honeycomb Wall to melt it down.
First we need our own Dragonfly. Unfortunately, the adults bond with a particular race, so one raised by the Umbra Legion or a Hundred Legger will never serve a Mouse.
I need you to go into the Hatchery Cave and get me a Dragonfly Egg. I'm sure the cavern will be guarded.
Head into the Hatchery Cave and get me a Dragonfly Egg. Watch out for guards!
